name: Restore User Data After Move
description: Finds played state, resume positions, favourites and ratings that Jellyfin stranded when a media path changed, and reports which current item each stranded snapshot belongs to. This release analyses only: it contains no task that can modify user data.
overview: Recovers user data Jellyfin stranded when media paths changed
